description: This PHP source file defines the PurgeEmployeeAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to delete (purge) employee data based on employee number. It includes route annotations, validation rules, service initialization, and a delete method implementation for handling purge requests within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for purging employee data, handling delete requests with employee number validation, utilizing a purge service, and implementing required interface methods.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of PurgeService used for employee data purging.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to purge an employee's data if the employee is purgeable; throws a BadRequestException otherwise.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules to ensure employee number is accessible and valid for purge operation.
